scope: Independent read-only source and integration review before the first trained-adapter visual pair; no execution admission is issued by this report.
closed_findings: The prepared reader now accepts the genuine unpadded native negative context with 126 tokens; the positive context has 25 tokens. Native model padding remains unchanged.
The child launcher rejects an expired shared deadline before Popen. The focused CPU suite includes this rejection and verifies that no child launches.
reviewed_contract: Both arms use the same hash-bound checkpoint 16, independently encoded starting observation, retained Gaussian noise and genuine positive/negative contexts. Only the first interaction command differs.
The corrected sampler keeps adapter parameter flags compatible with the unchanged bridge while inference uses no_grad and track_grad=False. Native core load and sampling have no outer inference_mode.
Commands are identical on both CFG branches of each arm. Native CPU UniPC uses 50 steps, shift 5 and guidance 5, with clean observed-prefix restoration and zero observed-token times.

Each arm saves all 50 post-update latent states and the final latent. Only the first step retains raw positive, negative and guided velocities; 100 calls per arm are supported by reviewed sampler counters.
Core and FP32 decoder execute in separate serialized child processes under one 1800-second deadline. Failure evidence, child cleanup and completed-first-arm artifacts are retained.

The prepared directory binds copied prior evidence, current source snapshots, checkpoint and condition files. Actual original-evidence preparation and an isolated self-contained read passed without model execution.
The decoder is configured to save 17 raw RGB frames and 17 authoritative PNGs per arm, with one conditioned initial reconstruction and 16 generated future frames.
limitations: This is a source/readiness review, not an actual CUDA visual execution or a quality result.
Checkpoint training used the development capture and positive context. This review establishes no generalization, action success or persistent-memory claim.
A worker deadline does not terminate provider billing. Exact-plan admission and the external lease/deletion controller remain the parent operator responsibility.
